output_contract.claim_rule: each factual statement references typed Σ/Ω or department evidence; each preference and recommendation is labeled
output_contract.confidence_rule: feature-derived and capped by weakest material evidence, constraint or authority dependency; LLM self-confidence is ignored
output_contract.minority_rule: material dissent is attached by reference and cannot be compressed away

unknown_policy.prohibition: absence of evidence is never silently converted to feasibility, value or permission

security.filesystem: artifact store and quarantined read-only workspace only
security.code_execution: sandboxed deterministic/notebook runs with manifest and no privileged credentials
security.secrets: references only; no prompt inclusion or output reproduction
